gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be lying on a beach right now.
gaps.sentence: I ___ lying on a beach right now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past subjunctive: I wish I were (formal 'were', not 'was').

gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective + that → such (+a) + adjective + noun + that.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.
